description: The Tensorust Ontology schema in one small answer: object types with counts, which types are searchable by name, every link type (from type, to type, meaning, count), the federal rules with their statuses and citations, the public data sources, query_ontology's parameters with worked examples, and which domain tool answers which question (private credit marks, banned-vendor research awards, set-aside performance, ROAD Act housing, FCC programs). Takes no arguments. Free.
name: describe_schema
title: Describe the ontology schema
